answer: An identity's answers must stay mutually consistent across epochs: a claim contradicted by its own later submission voids both, and the pair is flagged at replay. The cipher history is re-read at each close, echo lists the contradictions, and raven records the voided pairs. A farm that generates text cheaply cannot hold a coherent position over 7 epochs, and thus its own output eventually convicts it. Collateral of 42 dollars is at risk. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
